projects.name: PersonalPitcher
projects.description: A personal AI pitch platform that lets visitors ask questions about Davit's professional background, projects, community work, and interests using curated profile data and an LLM.
highlights: RAG-style retrieval from curated Markdown/JSON profile files
Local Ollama support with OpenAI fallback
Intent classification for profile, projects, community, hobbies, and off-topic questions
Guardrails to keep answers focused on Davit-related topics
IP-based rate limiting and request validation
Portfolio-style UI with AI assistant interaction

projects.name: DevFest Armenia 2025 Website
projects.description: Single-page PWA for DevFest Armenia 2025, built to present the event, speakers, agenda, workshops, partners, photos, and GDG Yerevan community information.
highlights: Progressive Web App with offline support
Responsive design with DevFest/GDG branding
Sessionize integration for agenda, sessions, speakers, and speaker wall
Google Photos gallery integration
WordPress subfolder deployment support
Docker-ready deployment and GitHub Actions CI/CD

projects.name: Calendar Bot
projects.description: Telegram bot that parses natural language text into calendar events and generates .ics files, with multilingual support and OpenAI fallback for complex or typo-heavy input.
highlights: Parses casual event descriptions in English, Armenian, and Russian
Uses regex-based parsing for fast common cases
Falls back to OpenAI for complex parsing and typos
Generates .ics files compatible with major calendar applications
Telegram bot interface with simple commands
Designed with future Google Calendar integration in mind

projects.name: Spring AI SpaceX MCP POC
projects.description: Spring Boot REST service that uses Spring AI and OpenAI to answer natural language questions about SpaceX data, with an MCP tool server for AI-agent integration.
highlights: Natural-language `/ask` endpoint backed by Spring AI
Integration with public SpaceX API data
MCP tool server for agent-style workflows
Docker and Docker Compose support
Unit tests and MockWebServer-based testing
Demonstrates practical Java/Spring AI-agent integration

projects.name: Menu PWA AI
projects.description: AI-powered Progressive Web App that scans restaurant menus via camera, extracts dishes, enriches them with descriptions and estimated nutrition, and supports offline usage.
highlights: Camera-based menu capture workflow
AI-powered dish extraction and parsing
Interactive editing of extracted menu items
AI enrichment with descriptions, nutrition estimates, and generated images
Offline support using Dexie and IndexedDB
PWA capabilities with Dockerized deployment

projects.name: Menu Flutter AI
projects.description: Flutter mobile app for Android and iOS that lets users capture or upload menu photos, parse dishes via an OpenAI-backed API, edit items, and request AI-generated enrichment.
highlights: Cross-platform mobile app for Android and iOS
Photo-based restaurant menu parsing
OpenAI-backed dish extraction and enrichment
Editable menu item workflow
Offline cache support
Clean architecture approach

projects.name: Hotel Contract Parser
projects.description: Java CLI tool that parses hotel-vendor contract PDFs, extracts metadata and page information, and generates DOCX reports, with OCR fallback for incomplete text extraction.
highlights: PDF parsing using Apache PDFBox
DOCX report generation using Apache POI
OCR fallback using Tess4J/Tesseract
Command-line interface with picocli
Dockerized execution
CI/CD build and test flow with GitHub Actions

projects.name: Weather Monitoring Service
projects.description: Distributed weather monitoring system with multiple warehouse services, sensor data ingestion, Kafka messaging, central monitoring, timeout handling, and Docker Compose orchestration.
highlights: Multi-service architecture with warehouse and central monitoring services
Kafka-based communication between services
Sensor data simulation over UDP/netcat
Timeout detection for warehouse failures
Warning generation for missing or problematic sensor data
Docker Compose setup for full local environment

projects.name: Nakama RPC
projects.description: Go-based Nakama RPC implementation that reads files, persists data, calculates content hashes, and responds through a game-server RPC flow with Docker-based end-to-end testing.
highlights: Custom Nakama RPC function implementation
Payload handling with type, version, and hash parameters
File reading and content hash calculation
PostgreSQL persistence
Docker Compose setup with Nakama, PostgreSQL, and PGAdmin
End-to-end tests running as a separate Docker service

projects.name: Scratch Game
projects.description: Java-based scratch game engine that generates a symbol matrix based on configurable probabilities and calculates rewards using standard and bonus symbol rules.
highlights: Configurable game engine using JSON-based rules
Probability-based matrix generation
Winning combination evaluation
Bonus symbol reward modification
CLI execution with configurable betting amount
Unit-tested game logic

projects.name: Spring Proxy Beans
projects.description: Spring Boot demo project explaining how a singleton service can safely interact with a proxied request-scoped bean while preserving request isolation and thread safety.
highlights: Demonstrates Spring request-scoped proxy behavior
Shows safe injection of request-scoped beans into singleton services
Includes endpoints for testing request-specific data isolation
Explains proxy routing and automatic cleanup
Useful educational project for Spring IoC concepts
